# ADR-3092: A08: Webhook without signature check for integration 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unsigned webhooks are forgeable.

## Decision

Integrations SHALL NOT accept a webhook without signature check for integration 8 (A08-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

HMAC or mTLS authenticates publishers.
